title: swaying grass
shortDescription: A night meadow on a floating island: hundreds of blades, reeds and flowers that bend in the wind, stand upright as the camera orbits and sway in their shadows
description:
A floating island of night meadow: 1100 grass blades, tufts, reeds and flowers in one `FeatureSprites` mesh, one draw call, bent by the wind and seen by a slowly orbiting perspective camera. The plant kind is `[InstancePosition, AxisBillboardPlacement, QuadSize, AtlasFrame, TextureColor, Tint, wave({weight: 'top'})]` on `gridBase({columns: 1, rows: 8})`, its quads standing on their feet through `baseArgs: [0.5, 0.5, 0, 0.5]`.

- **[`wave({weight: 'top'})`](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/sprites.md#waves-sway-and-scroller)** moves every vertex along +X by `waveAmplitude · (1 − uv.y)² · sin(phase)`: the foot stays, the top sways, and the phase runs across the meadow from `x + z` of each plant. The *wave* sliders set `waveAmplitude`, `waveFrequency` and `waveSpeed`; *gusts* swells the amplitude now and then.
- **[`gridBase()`](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/sprites.md#a-grid-base)** — *base* switches to a kind on `gridBase({columns: 1, rows: 4})`, `rows: 2` or `QuadBase`, each a mesh of its own: on the quad the same wave only shears the plant, its stem straight; on the grid every row line moves by its own weight, and the plant bends. Turn the amplitude up to see it.
- **[`axisBillboardPlacement()`](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/sprites.md#axis-billboards)** turns every plant about +Y to the camera and keeps it upright. *placement* swaps in `BillboardPlacement` on the live material: drag the camera up, and the spherical billboards lean back with it until they lie on the floor.
- **[`ShadowPass`](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/sprites.md#passes-shadows-and-reflections)** throws the moon shadows onto the floor. The wave is a mesh stage and the pass draws the mesh stages of the kind, so the shadows sway with their plants; the meadow keeps its tall plants back from the rim on the side the shadows fall to, since a shadow lies in the infinite ground plane.
- **The atlas** `meadow.png` + `meadow.json` is free-tex-packer's "JSON (hash)" export, read by `TextureStore` through `TexturePackerJson` unchanged — the [atlas adapter](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/sprites.md#frames-out-of-an-atlas) is picked by `meta.app`.
- **The glow** follows the [glow recipe](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/sprites.md#glow-emissive-sprites-with-bloom): `Tint` lifts the glowcaps, the lumen lilies and the fireflies above white, and `createBloomOutputNodeBuilder({threshold: 1})` on a `StageRenderer` lets only them into the bloom. The `Stage2D` has no projection; it renders with the orbiting `PerspectiveCamera` it is handed.

No `sortByViewDepth()`: the pixel art has no soft edge, so the plants are cut by `alphaTest: 0.5` and the depth test sorts them per pixel. The assets are generated by `apps/lookbook/assets-src/swaying-grass/`.
